f1_guide_verbatim.Living & sofa sets: Create a complete residential lounge. Preserve every module, seat count, open side, arm, cushion and orientation. Arrange the conversation area around sourced Midas center and side tables when provided. Do not merge or redesign modules to force a corner.
f1_guide_verbatim.Dining sets: Preserve the exact requested number of chairs including armchairs. Arrange chairs around the table with believable spacing and countable backs. For twelve chairs use five each long side and one at each head unless the source specifies otherwise. Use only sourced dining props. Keep place settings coherent and the tabletop edge and base legible.
f1_guide_verbatim.Bedroom sets: Retain all supplied pieces, including both nightstands, dresser, mirror and stool when present. A dresser never replaces a nightstand. Plan a complete room with sightlines to required pieces. Bedding colour changes only when requested.
f1_guide_verbatim.Chairs: Make the supplied chair or pair prominent in a relevant residential corner or lounge. Preserve front and rear finishes and all legs. For two chairs show exactly two. No original excluded table. Keep the view close enough to read upholstery and silhouette.
f1_guide_verbatim.Tables: Show the whole tabletop, perimeter and base in a relevant living or side-table vignette. Supporting decor stays low or off-center so distinctive grain, inlays, openings and sculptural supports remain legible. No extra table unless explicitly selected.
f1_guide_verbatim.Accessories: Treat the supplied accessory as the hero. Use a close product-led vignette with a believable supporting surface. Preserve rim, handles, wings, transparency, thickness and finish. Match reflections and contact shadows to the scene. Never bury it in a wide room or replace it with a generic ornament.
f1_guide_verbatim.Lighting: Treat the supplied lamp or fixture as the hero. Preserve shade, supports, globe count, cord and mounting. Use a plausible mounting surface. Distinguish ambient scene lighting from fixture emission, with readable finishes and controlled highlights.
f1_guide_verbatim.Automatic: Use the images to identify the hero and complete set. Choose a setting suited to their use. If category is unclear, keep supporting products minimal.
